A modern IPTV player. It loads the [iptv-org](https://github.com/iptv-org/iptv) public playlist and the [epgshare01](https://epgshare01.online/) TV guide by default.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| **Android** (phones, tablets, Android TV · Android 7.0+) | `LumenTV-<version>.apk` |

### Installing

- **Android**: download the APK on your device and open it. Allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser or file manager when asked.
  On Android TV, sideload it with a file manager or `adb install`.

## What's new in 1.11.1

- **Android TV: Back goes straight to Home** from any screen in the side menu (TV guide, Search, All channels, Settings), instead of stepping back through every screen you visited. On Home, press Back twice to exit.
- **Phones: the bottom navigation hides while the full player is open.** Minimize the player (the ⌄ button or Back) to bring it back.
- **Phones: no mini player over Search**, leaving room for the results and the keyboard.
- **TV guide grid and All channels filters** (from 1.11.0).
